categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflows, custom actions, and CI container setup scripts across .github/ and ci/ to share downloaded test assets.
categories.rationale: Resolves intermittent CI job failures caused by HTTP 504 gateway timeouts during repetitive qa-assets downloads across runners, as reported in #36814. Downloading assets once per workflow run and sharing them as artifacts directly improves CI reliability and reduces redundant bandwidth usage across all platforms.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates test asset download and verification utilities in test/download_utils.py (+153/-10).
categories.rationale: Implements SHA-256 manifest verification and local artifact extraction for unit test vectors and fuzz corpora in test/download_utils.py. It resolves flaky test starts due to network download failures, though the primary leverage is in CI workflow orchestration.
